summary: Electron Hub's $0 Free tier provides $0.25 in weekly API credits refilled every Sunday at 21:00 UTC, plus 10 Neutrinos per day for :free-suffixed models, expandable to 200 by watching up to three ads. Ordinary weekly balances reset rather than automatically accumulating. The documented Flex Wallet permits saving up to 20% of weekly credits per week, capped at 50% of the weekly allowance; saved Flex credits roll over until used and are used after the regular balance runs out if enabled. Current pricing lists a 5-requests-per-minute Free limit. Failed, cancelled and successful :free requests consume Neutrinos; regular credits are charged only for successful or cancelled requests, not failed ones. Signup is through Google or Discord; the checked public sources do not explicitly confirm a card requirement or waiver, and no account grant was tested. Additional Free limits apply: Google experimental/preview/image models have 10 requests/day; Claude has 50 requests/day and 100K combined input/output tokens/month; OpenAI has 100K combined tokens/month. Daily caps reset at 21:00 UTC and monthly token caps at 21:00 UTC on the first. Check current model-specific limits before use.
claim_steps: Sign in or create an account at app.electronhub.ai through Google or Discord and choose the advertised $0 Free tier. Check account-specific billing requirements; no account grant or card waiver was tested.
Weekly credits land automatically every Sunday 21:00 UTC; Neutrinos reset daily at 21:00 UTC.
Call models ending in :free to spend Neutrinos instead of credits; watch ads in the dashboard to raise the daily Neutrino cap to 200. Failed and cancelled :free requests also consume Neutrinos.
Keep Free-tier traffic within the current 5-requests-per-minute limit. Regular credits are charged only for successful or cancelled requests; failed regular-credit requests are not charged.

Inspect Flex Wallet settings to save up to 20% of weekly credits per week, capped at 50% of the weekly allowance. Saved Flex credits roll over until used; enable Flex to use them after regular balance runs out. Ordinary weekly balance resets.

Check model-specific Free caps: Google experimental/preview/image models 10 requests/day; Claude 50/day plus 100K tokens/month; OpenAI 100K tokens/month (combined input/output). Daily resets are 21:00 UTC; monthly token resets are 21:00 UTC on the first.

social_proof.title: Understanding Credits — Electron Hub Docs
social_proof.text: Weekly Credits are automatically added to your account every Sunday at 21:00 UTC; Free tier receives $0.25. All users get 10 Neutrinos per day (resets 21:00 UTC); earn more by watching ads, up to 200 daily.

social_proof.title: Electron Hub Flex Wallet and request charging rules
social_proof.text: You can save up to 20% of your weekly credits per week to your flex wallet. The total cap is 50% of your weekly credits. Flex balance rolls over until you use it. Regular Credits: Only charged for successful and cancelled requests. Failed requests are NOT charged. Neutrinos: Charged for all requests (failed, cancelled, and successful).
